_note: Voice casting for Down Is Where I Say (1st person, past tense: Dagny Quillon). Dagny's own lines stay on the narrator voice (gemini.voices c-dagny-quillon = "narrator"). gemini.narrator overrides config/tts.json gemini.narrator. Voices kept distinct from knot-mender. lexicon: Kokoro IPA; respell: Gemini only. Cast 2026-11-13, not yet approved by Ben.

respell._note: Gemini only: words replaced in the text sent to Gemini.

narrator.style: Plain, earnest young woman from a northern English mining town telling her own story straight; low, steady and physical; fear held tight in a controlled voice, never jokey; numbers said carefully, with weight; measured pace with clear pauses between paragraphs

c-rafe-quillon.style: Fast, jokey, excitable sixteen-year-old northern English lad; deflects with gallows humour; ends sentences on a question

c-mattias-osk.style: Old northern English shaft gaffer; low and slow, long pause before the important word; never raises his voice

c-hal-stenning.style: Hoarse, tired northern English man of few words, hurting and trying to hide it

c-dunnet-haig.style: Big, booming, laughing northern English man; grim jokes said to cheer the others

c-lisbet-garrow.style: Quick, practical, impatient northern English woman, a rope-maker; short commands

c-pru-ambry.style: Fast, sharp northern English bookie's patter, calling odds; shouting down a shaft when live

c-sibbald-teague.style: Soft, courteous, precise moneylender; gentle as a man reading a hymn number; quietly menacing
